explanation: When the compare branch of an open PR receives a new commit, the PR's current compare commit must be updated and all existing review decisions on the old commit must become stale. save-new-file moves the branch head to a new commit but leaves pr-1.compareCommit at c-5, so the existing Approve remains effective instead of being invalidated.
subject: eligibility
check: const repo=ARC.state.repos.find(r=>r.id==='repo-acme-docs');const pr=ARC.state.pulls.find(p=>p.id==='pr-1');const before=ARC.state.branches.find(b=>b.name==='onboarding-update').commitId;const history=ARC.state.reviews.length;saveNewFile({id:repo.id,data:{branch:'onboarding-update'},form:{path:'new.md',content:'new',message:'Add new.md'}});assert.notEqual(ARC.state.branches.find(b=>b.name==='onboarding-update').commitId,before);assert.equal(ARC.state.reviews.length,history);assert.equal(eligibility(repo,pr,ARC.state.users.find(u=>u.id==='u-alice')).ok,false,'approval on old commit must not permit merge');

explanation: A reviewer's new decision must replace that reviewer's effective decision on the current compare commit while preserving the old record as history. After bob-reviewer already has an Approve on pr-1/c-5, submitting a Comment pushes a second current-commit review; both the Approve and Comment remain in the effective reviews list, so an old Approve can still satisfy approval requirements.
subject: eligibility

explanation: Repository identity and duplicate validation are scoped to the selected owner namespace. create-repo rejects any repository whose bare name already exists anywhere in the system, so creating a personal repository named acme-docs is blocked by an existing acme-demo/acme-docs organization repository even though the personal namespace has no conflict.
subject: createRepo

explanation: An issue title is limited to 1-256 non-empty characters, and overlong input must retain the original title. save-title only rejects an empty title, so submitting a 257-character title to the seeded issue overwrites 'Original issue title' instead of preserving it.
subject: saveTitle
